{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final dataset after all cleaning steps
df_final = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

df_final['revenue_clean'] = df_final['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
suspicious_revenue = df_final['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_final = df_final[~suspicious_revenue]
df_final = df_final[df_final['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rates by channel
total_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel').size()
converted_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].sum()

conversion_rate_by_channel = converted_by_channel / total_by_channel

# Compute difference: email minus paid_search
difference = conversion_rate_by_channel['email'] - conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rate - email: {conversion_rate_by_channel['email']:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate - paid_search: {conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
